quote: Okay. So you just need to go to your camera roll and then just find the picture.
stewart_read: Customer is struggling with basic phone navigation; the schema calls for a pivot to verbal read-back within 2 minutes, but the rep continues screen-by-screen guidance.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the customer close to success and worth pushing through rather than restarting via verbal readback.
coaching_implication: Set a 2-minute clock: if the customer is still lost, switch to 'just read me the kWh number off the bill' instead of continuing tech support.

quote: And and, you know, ecological and also being independent.
stewart_read: Customer gives two distinct motivations (environmental + energy independence) but the rep only echoes one word ('Independent. Awesome.') and moves on without expanding.
alternative_hypothesis: Given the call was already running long due to the bill struggle, rep may have been managing time rather than skipping the anchor deliberately.
coaching_implication: A 10-second follow-up ('independence — like backup power, or just not relying on the utility?') would have deepened the anchor for the closer's handoff.

quote: Do you do you have a credit score over six seventy?

alternative_hypothesis: If genuinely customer-spoken, it would be nonsensical; near-certain speaker-label error, consistent with known diarization issues on short/adjacent lines.
coaching_implication: No coaching action — flagging for transcript quality only, not attributable to rep behavior.
